generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
ALL OTHER TERMS AND CONDITIONS ARE AS PER TENDER DOCUMENT

technicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer shall Satisfactorily completed at least One contract as a prime contractor for similar work (Design, Supply, Erection & Commissioning of minimum 3000 KVA & above capacity Transformer including 2 Nos x 1500 KVA & above capacity DG set with accessories and 1 No x 400 KVA & above capacity UPS and other HT related works) in dairy or any other industries.
The prime contractor shall have executed at least 1. one contract of 24 Crores (80 PERCENT of the estimated value) or 2. two contracts of more than 15 Cr (50 PERCENT of the estimated value) each.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Bidder shall invariably furnish documentary evidence in support of the P.O copies and satisfactory operation work  done  certificates.

technicalCriterionList.description: Tenderer / Bidder should poses valid Super grade Electrical License Holder issued by CEIG, Govt. of Karnataka as on date of bid submission. The bidder should be a Super grade Electrical Contractor of HT Electrical works similar to the type specified in the schedule of requirements which shall be in successful operation for at least three years as on the date of bid opening.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Proof   of  document  to  be furnished.

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should execute the civil works with Sib contractor, Sub contractor must have CLASS 1 PWD Civil contractor having a experience of satisfactorily completed as prime contractor at least one similar work (similar nature of work only) of value not less than 50 percent civil estimated value of contract Rs. 50.00 Lakhs.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Bidder shall invariably furnish documentary evidence

technicalCriterionList.description: Documents in respect of achievement of at least in 2 Financial years, a Minimum each year financial turnover not less than Rs. 30 Crores in any last three years.
Reports on financial standing of the bidder such as profit and loss statements, balance sheets and auditors report of the past three years, bankers certificates etc:
